title: Tensor algebra functor lifts and linear affine comparison
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with A and B R-algebras, and i an integer. There are functors S,T from unbounded A-complexes to modules over A tensor_R B, natural B-linear restriction isomorphisms eS,eT to source and target [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology], and a natural transformation c:S to T. Under eS and eT, multiplication by a tensor 1 agrees with source and target applied to multiplication by a on M. Restriction of c followed by eT equals eS followed by comparison. No localization assertion is made.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine proof, A tensor_R B actions and linearity of the cohomology comparison

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-affine-tensor-cohomology-additive-scalar]. For every object, apply [lem-pc-tensor-action-additive-functor] to obtain its tensor algebra module and B-linear identification. Conjugate the original functor maps by these identifications. Naturality of A-scalar endomorphisms proves A-equivariance; B-linearity and tensor induction prove full tensor-algebra linearity. Conjugation identities give functor laws and the restriction natural isomorphism. All these steps are proved in the private helpers liftMap and exists_functorLift.

Apply the functor lifting construction separately to source and target. Conjugate each component of comparison by the two identifications. Naturality of comparison for a times identity gives A-equivariance. Tensor induction again yields tensor-algebra linearity. Faithfulness of restriction and cancellation of eT prove naturality. Cancel the identification and its inverse to prove that restriction of the lifted comparison is exactly comparison.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineTensorCohomologyLifts (R A B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (i : ℤ) : ∃ (S T : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B)) (eS : S ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≅ source R A B i) (eT : T ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≅ target R A B i) (c : S ⟶ T), (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a : A) (x : S.obj M), eS.hom.app M ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) a : A ⊗[R] B) • x) = (source R A B i).map (a • 𝟙 M) (eS.hom.app M x)) ∧ (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a : A) (x : T.obj M), eT.hom.app M ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) a : A ⊗[R] B) • x) = (target R A B i).map (a • 𝟙 M) (eT.hom.app M x)) ∧ Functor.whiskerRight c (ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) ≫ eT.hom = eS.hom ≫ comparison R A B i
